data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 16, *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this section compares patent application counts by computer-implemented invention (CII) group at IP Australia, the EPO and the USPTO in 2001–20. It explains the CII-PSM-likely-adverse and CII-PSM-likely-clear classifications as machine-learning predictions of whether IP Australia examiners would object for lack of patentable subject matter.
